caption: Lago di Braies, Braies
composition: Alpine lake with boat house and mountain reflection · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera rests at the water's edge of Lago di Braies in the misty calm of the 06:53 dawn. A wooden boathouse and a cluster of rowboats occupy the left foreground, while the massive craggy mountain fills the center, mirrored almost perfectly in the glassy green water. Low mist drifts across the far shore, pine forest lines the right bank, and the soft pre-sunrise light lends the whole scene a hushed, silvery stillness.
